rule_versions.held_out: ROB-01 homoglyph (never used for training augmentation; refused, C08)

rules.aug01: build_dev_cases.ROB01[subtype] (ROB-01 v1 operations case, space, char) on new train originals with new seeds; the held-out method homoglyph is refused
rules.aug03: pair i shares its passages across labels; position (prefix, suffix, both)[i % 3]; assigned block: 25 of the 50 prefix and 25 of the 50 suffix pairs get one long passage (seeded sample), the others one short; reserve block: prefix and suffix pairs get one long passage; both = two short; first of at most 20 queue candidates (planned class, then the other) with <= 256 tokens for both cases and all three tokenizers; a passage is used by one pair only
rules.aug04_aug05: items of a family in file order: the first K passing items are assigned, later passing items are reserves
rules.checks: validation rows: exact / normalised key / punct key -> exclude; train rows: exact -> exclude, key match with another label -> exclude (label_conflict), same label -> flag for AUG-01/03 (train-derived), exclude (train_material) for AUG-04/05 (new LLM text); development material: exact / key -> exclude, AUG-04/05 also a one-word edit; duplicate inside the set -> the later case excluded; > 256 tokens -> exclude; LLM text format -> exclude
rules.eligible_original: ASCII, no line break, 4-40 words, none of the surface patterns alternating_case, spaced_letters, multiple_spaces, leetspeak, all_caps_row
rules.review: pending | keep | exclude; exclude -> review_excluded, not replaced; usable = assigned and keep
rules.selection: per label (1, 0) the sorted train_clean IDs are shuffled once and walked; slot groups case, space, char (label 1, then 0), then context; 150 assigned + 15 reserve passing candidates per group; a failing candidate is auto_excluded and skipped; one case per original
rules.test_overlap: levels A and B from test_overlap.json (scripts/check_cases_vs_test.py), applied only when its pool_sha256 equals the current pool; a matching assigned case is replaced by the next non-matching reserve of its slot group
rules.train_aug: written only when the test overlap is applied and no review row is pending

seeds.aug03: random.Random('aug03-v1'): long-passage samples (assigned prefix pairs, assigned suffix pairs), short queue, long queue

definitions.all_caps_row: >= 4 cased characters and no lowercase character in the row
definitions.alternating_case: an ASCII letter run of >= 4 letters whose case alternates at every letter
definitions.leetspeak: a token (maximal ASCII letter/digit run) of letters and the digits 0 1 3 4 5 7 with at least one of each whose de-leeted form (0->o, 1->i or l, 3->e, 4->a, 5->s, 7->t) is a word of >= 3 letters occurring as an all-letter token in the train or validation texts (base64-like fragments, codes and numbers such as mp3 or 4k do not count)
definitions.multiple_spaces: two or more spaces between non-space characters
definitions.non_ascii: a non-ASCII character (README 3.2: all such train rows are injections, a shortcut candidate)
definitions.spaced_letters: >= 4 single ASCII letters separated by single spaces

train_patterns_after.scopes: train_clean; augmentation_assigned (status assigned); augmentation_usable (assigned and keep); after = train_clean + augmentation_usable
train_patterns_after.vocabulary: leetspeak vocabulary: all-letter tokens of >= 3 letters in the raw train and validation rows (as build_dev_cases.train_patterns)
